title: Codex-Bridge Brief
description: Structured handoff document for `task --brief @path.json`. Captures the orchestrator's privileged context (goal, worker assignment, behavior digest, specific concerns, acceptance criteria) so the worker subagent has everything it needs without re-deriving from scratch.

schema_version.description: Pinned to 1.0 in v2.0; bumps on breaking field changes.

goal.description: One-paragraph distillation of the user-facing outcome.

worker_assignment.description: What the adapter must actually do, written for the adapter (not the user).

behavior_digest_seed.description: What the orchestrator already knows about prior worker behavior (from Monitor events).

specific_concerns.description: Concrete issues the orchestrator wants the worker to address. Surfaces in `prompts/adversarial-review.md` as `{{OPUS_CONCERNS}}`.

parent_task_id.description: For iteration loops; links a child task to its parent in the artifact registry.

backend_hint.description: Preferred adapter. Only `codex` valid in v2.0; expanded as adapters land.

iteration_max.description: Closed-loop cap for `--iterate`. Defaults to 3 when omitted.

trust_budget_override.description: Task-specific budget for the auto-merge gate.
